# 06. Testing Assumptions {#sensitivity}

**Monte Carlo sensitivity analysis.** Because many inputs are uncertain, CERAI can run a simulation that repeatedly varies the uncertain inputs within plausible ranges and observes how often the conclusion changes. This shows the decision-maker whether the assessment is robust or whether it hinges on a few uncertain assumptions.

**What-if pressure test.** The tool identifies the handful of variables that most strongly influence the outcome and lets the user adjust them to see the effect immediately. This supports scenario planning without altering the main assessment.
